dataset.purpose: Highlight material State/UT and cross-State differences affecting vehicle owners and riders.
dataset.policy: Never infer a State-specific exemption, tax amount, enforcement relaxation or restriction without a current authoritative source.

items.baseline: Section 129 of the Motor Vehicles Act requires protective headgear for persons above four years driving, riding or being carried on a motorcycle in a public place, subject to the statutory exemption and applicable rules.
items.state_difference: State/UT enforcement, notifications, exemptions and local implementation must be checked separately. RTOBuddy must never describe an enforcement relaxation as a general exemption from the central requirement.
items.owner_action: Before travelling across a State/UT boundary, check the destination State/UT transport/police guidance for current helmet requirements and exemptions.

items.baseline: Section 194B provides a penalty framework for driving without a safety belt or carrying passengers not wearing seat belts, with a statutory provision allowing specified transport-vehicle exclusions by State Government notification.
items.state_difference: Vehicle class, notification-based exclusions and enforcement details must be checked against the current State/UT position.
items.owner_action: Treat seat-belt use as mandatory by default and verify any claimed exemption against a current official notification.

items.baseline: Motor-vehicle taxation is substantially a State/UT subject. A vehicle registered in one State can therefore encounter destination-State taxation or compliance provisions when used or kept there under the applicable conditions.
items.state_difference: Tax rates, periods, exemptions, payment procedures and treatment of vehicles registered outside the State vary by jurisdiction.
items.owner_action: Before keeping an out-of-State vehicle in another State for an extended period, check the destination State's motor-vehicle taxation law and transport-department guidance.

items.baseline: Karnataka has a separate Karnataka Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1957. The current Act text includes provisions and schedules dealing with motor-vehicle tax, including provisions relevant to vehicles registered outside Karnataka.
items.state_difference: The exact tax liability depends on the vehicle, registration status, period, use and the current Karnataka law/notifications. Do not reduce this to a claim that all outside-State vehicles owe the same tax.
items.owner_action: For a vehicle registered outside Karnataka, check current Karnataka Transport Department guidance and the applicable taxation provision before prolonged use in Karnataka.

items.baseline: Section 47 of the Motor Vehicles Act addresses assignment of a new registration mark when a motor vehicle registered in one State has been kept in another State beyond the statutory period.
items.state_difference: State procedures, documents, tax-clearance requirements and forms must be checked with the destination registering authority.
items.owner_action: If the vehicle is being relocated rather than temporarily visiting, check re-registration/new-mark requirements early.

items.baseline: Permit validity and use outside the granting region are governed by the Motor Vehicles Act and applicable permit provisions.
items.state_difference: Route, permit class, taxes, authorisations and State-level requirements can differ by destination and vehicle/service type.
items.owner_action: Commercial/transport operators should verify the exact permit and tax requirements before entering another State.

items.baseline: Vehicle fitness, registration validity and environmental/local restrictions can involve both central rules and State/local measures.
items.state_difference: Age thresholds, restricted zones, fitness practices and local environmental restrictions can differ by jurisdiction and vehicle category.
items.owner_action: Check the destination jurisdiction before long-term relocation or operation of an older vehicle.

items.baseline: Local authorities may impose traffic-management restrictions, route controls, parking controls, silence zones and other notified restrictions within their legal powers.
items.state_difference: The actual restriction, location, timing and enforcement mechanism may differ by city, district and State/UT.
items.owner_action: Check current local police/transport notifications when travelling to a new city or region.
